messages:
maya: Heads-up: EUFin (regulatory fintech) needs an audit-ready evidence bundle for a Dedicated POC. Ask: SOC 2 (Type II) summary, ISO27001 cert + scope, signed pen-test attestation, and a 14-day read-only auditor view of logs. This is gating the PO. Can we turn around today?
liam: Quick clarifying q: do they want the full SOC 2 report or just the control test evidence? Also need preferred signer for the attestation (CTO/legal).
maya: They asked for SOC 2 report excerpts and supporting test evidence (not the full report). Signer: Legal prefers the Head of Trust or General Counsel.
ana: @ana (security) here. We have a pen-test attestation template but will limit details: high-level findings + remediation status. We can provide RBAC S3 read-only for 14 days and a timestamped log export. No raw exploit POCs.
eli: Pricing note: for Dedicated POC we can grant a temporary 20% reserved-capacity credit for a 2-month trial. If customer insists on Hosted POC only, offer a $7k usage credit. Which to lead with?
maya: Lead with Dedicated (they prioritize latency guarantees). Use the 20% credit in the email.
liam: I'll assemble a sanitized bundle and redact any internal IPs/customer names. Bundle draft includes:
```
- SOC2: executive summary + control-test index + 2 sample evidence screenshots
- ISO27001: cert.pdf + scope-annex.pdf (data flow and VPC zones)
- Pen-test attestation: pen_attest_v1.docx (to be signed)
- Ops: log-export-instructions.md + retention-policy-90d.pdf
- Pricing: Dedicated-POC-credit-sheet.pdf
```
maya: Customer timeline: they want to start auditor review Wed morning CET. Can legal sign before EOD tomorrow?
jon: Jon (legal). I can review and sign the attestation, routing to gc@redwood.ai. Expect 24-48 hours. If they add liability/NDA clauses we may need additional review.
ana: Security question: they asked about KMS/HSM access. We can provide KMS metadata and key rotation records, but no key material. Confirm that's acceptable with them.
liam: Uploaded preliminary bundle: https://drive.internal/rw/evidence/eufin-poc-v0. Link access: maya, liam, ana, jon, eli. Pen attestation draft uploaded as pen_attest_v1.docx.
drive-bot: File uploaded by liam: https://drive.internal/rw/evidence/eufin-poc-v0 — viewers: maya, liam, ana, jon, eli.
maya: OK I'll send a cover note to nadia@eufin.eu with the bundle link, proposed 14-day audit window, and the 20% credit. @jon please confirm once countersigned so I can finalize the PO.
jon: Routing to legal now. Will confirm signature or blockers within business day. If they request on-site audit or full disk access, we'll need SOW and SRE coordination.
liam: Sending customer checklist with the bundle now. 
maya: Thanks everyone — cc'ing sales-eng to keep POC infra ready :thumbsup:
